definitions.name: S0D.SUM
definitions.note: Sum of a Vector of numbers (0 for an empty one).

definitions.name: S0D.PRESENT
definitions.note: The non-NIL elements of a Vector, in order.

definitions.name: S0D.MEAN
definitions.body: 'P' BIND P S0D.SUM P LENGTH DIV
definitions.note: Mean of a non-empty Vector of numbers.

definitions.name: S0D.FFILL
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V V S0D.PRESENT 0 GET [ 'X' BIND 'A' BIND A X X NIL? SELECT ] SCAN
definitions.note: Forward-fill: each NIL takes the nearest present element before it; leading NILs take the first present element.

definitions.name: S0D.GAP-STARTS
definitions.body: [ NIL? ] MAP 'M' BIND M [ FALSE ] M -1 DROP CONCAT NOT AND
definitions.note: Truth Vector marking each position that begins a run of NILs.

definitions.name: S0D.COUNT-TRUE
definitions.note: How many lanes of a truth Vector are TRUE.

definitions.name: S0D.LONGEST-GAP
definitions.body: 0 [ 'X' BIND 'A' BIND A 1 ADD 0 X NIL? SELECT ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: Length of the longest run of consecutive NILs in a Vector (0 if none).

definitions.name: S0D.RATIOS
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V 1 DROP V -1 DROP DIV
definitions.note: Each element divided by the one before it (one shorter than the input); NIL where either is NIL.

definitions.name: S0D.SCALED
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V V S0D.PRESENT 'P' BIND P P 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD DIV
definitions.note: Each element divided by the largest present element; NILs stay NIL.

definitions.name: S0D.ORDERS
definitions.note: Decode a JSON text and take its 'orders' array (a Vector of Records).

definitions.name: S0D.REVENUE
definitions.body: [ 'price' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'R' BIND R 'qty' GET R 'price' GET MUL ] MAP S0D.SUM
definitions.note: Sum of qty times price over the order Records that hold a 'price' key.

definitions.name: S0D.QTY-BY-SKU
definitions.body: 'O' BIND O [ 'sku' GET ] MAP O [ 'qty' GET ] MAP GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ S0D.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Record from each 'sku' to the sum of its 'qty' over a Vector of order Records, keys in order of first appearance.

definitions.name: S0D.ARGMAX-KEY
definitions.body: 'T' BIND T KEYS T VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
definitions.note: The key of a Record whose numeric value is largest; on ties the earliest key.

definitions.name: S0D.WORDS
definitions.note: Split a text on spaces into its words, dropping empty pieces from repeated or edge spaces.

definitions.name: S0D.UNWORDS
definitions.body: [ 'X' BIND ' ' X 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
definitions.note: Join a Vector of texts with single spaces.

definitions.name: S0D.TITLE-WORD
definitions.body: LOWER CHARS 'C' BIND C 0 GET UPPER 1 COLLECT C 1 DROP CONCAT JOIN
definitions.note: A word with its first letter upper-cased and the rest lower-cased.

solutions.orders.unpriced: S0D.ORDERS [ 'price' HAS? NOT ] FILTER [ 'sku' GET ] MAP UNIQUE
solutions.orders.tag_counts: S0D.ORDERS [ 'tags' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'tags' GET UNIQUE ] MAP FLATTEN TALLY
solutions.messy.title: S0D.WORDS [ S0D.TITLE-WORD ] MAP S0D.UNWORDS
